options.name: attributeInfo
options.description: Discovery's attributeInfo.

options.name: cdpLevel
options.description: CDP level to which neighbor devices are to be discovered.

options.name: deviceIds
options.description: Ids of the devices discovered in a discovery.

options.name: discoveryCondition
options.description: To indicate the discovery status. Available options Complete or In Progress.

options.name: discoveryStatus
options.description: Status of the discovery. Available options are Active, Inactive, Edit.

options.name: discoveryType
options.description: Type of the discovery. 'Single', 'Range', 'Multi Range', 'CDP', 'LLDP', 'CIDR'.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: enablePasswordList
options.description: Enable Password of the devices to be discovered.

options.name: globalCredentialIdList
options.description: Global Credential Ids to be used for discovery.

options.name: httpReadCredential
options.description: Discovery's httpReadCredential.

options.name: httpWriteCredential
options.description: Discovery's httpWriteCredential.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique Discovery Id.

options.name: ipAddressList
options.description: IP Address of devices to be discovered. Ex '172.30.0.1' for SINGLE, CDP and LLDP; '72.30.0.1-172.30.0.4' for RANGE; '72.30.0.1-172.30.0.4,172.31.0.1-172.31.0.4' for MULTI RANGE; '172.30.0.1/20' for CIDR.

options.name: ipFilterList
options.description: IP Addresses of the devices to be filtered out during discovery.

options.name: isAutoCdp
options.description: Flag to mention if CDP discovery or not.

options.name: lldpLevel
options.description: LLDP level to which neighbor devices to be discovered.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the discovery.

options.name: netconfPort
options.description: Netconf Port. It will need valid SSH credentials to work.

options.name: numDevices
options.description: Number of devices discovered in the discovery.

options.name: parentDiscoveryId
options.description: Parent Discovery Id from which the discovery was initiated.

options.name: passwordList
options.description: Password of the devices to be discovered.

options.name: preferredMgmtIPMethod
options.description: Preferred Management IP Method.'None' or 'UseLoopBack'. Default is 'None'.

options.name: protocolOrder
options.description: Order of protocol (ssh/telnet) in which device connection will be tried. Ex 'telnet' only telnet; 'ssh,telnet' ssh with higher order than telnet.

options.name: retry
options.description: Number of times to try establishing connection to device.

options.name: retryCount
options.description: Number of times to try establishing connection to device.

options.name: snmpAuthPassphrase
options.description: Auth passphrase for SNMP.

options.name: snmpAuthProtocol
options.description: SNMP auth protocol. SHA' or 'MD5'.

options.name: snmpMode
options.description: Mode of SNMP. 'AUTHPRIV' or 'AUTHNOPRIV' or 'NOAUTHNOPRIV'.

options.name: snmpPrivPassphrase
options.description: Pass phrase for SNMP privacy.

options.name: snmpPrivProtocol
options.description: SNMP privacy protocol. 'AES128'.

options.name: snmpRoCommunity
options.description: SNMP RO community of the devices to be discovered.

options.name: snmpRoCommunityDesc
options.description: Description for SNMP RO community.

options.name: snmpRwCommunity
options.description: SNMP RW community of the devices to be discovered.

options.name: snmpRwCommunityDesc
options.description: Description for SNMP RW community.

options.name: snmpUserName
options.description: SNMP username of the device.

options.name: snmpVersion
options.description: Version of SNMP. V2 or v3.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to wait for device response in seconds.

options.name: updateMgmtIp
options.description: Updates Management IP if multiple IPs are available for a device. If set to true, when a device is rediscovered with a different IP, the management IP is updated. Default value is false.

options.name: userNameList
options.description: Username of the devices to be discovered.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
